components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action CTA button for request quotes and free estimates.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0b6eb3; color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 50px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(11, 110, 179, 0.3); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #08558c; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(11, 110, 179, 0.45); }

components.name: White Call Button
components.description: High contrast white action button for direct phone hotline calling.
components.css: .ds-btn-white { background: #ffffff; color: #1c1367; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 50px; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-white:hover { background: #e6f3fa; color: #0b6eb3; transform: translateY(-2px); }

narrative.overview: Gunite Pools Renovations uses a vibrant, high-trust coastal aesthetic tailored for New England homeowners and commercial pool operators. The atmosphere combines deep nautical navy tones, luminous sky-blue reflections, crisp white card containers, and warm gold CTA highlights.
keyCharacteristics: High-Trust Contrast: Deep navy headers and section anchors offset by bright ocean blue primary actions.
Pill & Curve Forms: Soft rounded pill buttons (50px radius) and rounded card corners (20px).
Interactive Visual Proof: Embedded touch-friendly Before & After comparison slider and live texture simulator.
Direct Accessibility: Clear contact hotline and regional coverage tags accessible from any viewport.

rules.name: The Rarity of Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold (#f59e0b) is reserved strictly for high-value trust badges and phone call highlights. It never replaces primary button fills.

dos: Do use assets/logo.png in circular brand containers for header and footer logos.
Do maintain smooth CSS transitions (all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) on interactive components.
Do ensure phone numbers ((978) 596-4103) and email (poolsrenovation@hotmail.com) are linked via tel: and mailto: protocols.
donts: Don't use sharp 0px corners on interactive buttons or service cards.
Don't re-introduce the 15+ years experience badge or estimate calculator section.
Don't use generic default blue colors; always use the design system's --ocean-blue (#0b6eb3) and --navy-primary (#1c1367).
